investigation_notes.Recent Host Events: Prior events show this host queried github.com (A) at 2026-02-06T15:15:00Z and performed an NS query for cdn-check-cache.top at 2026-02-06T15:20:05Z.
investigation_notes.Description: Large TXT DNS responses (2,840 bytes vs typical 12 bytes) to cdn-check-cache.top were observed from srv-linux-prod-db. The root domain is newly registered (28 days old) and is not recognized as a known legitimate service, raising risk. Subdomain labels contain high-entropy Base64 strings which decode to sensitive artifacts including an RSA private key header, an admin credential-like string, a User-Agent string, and an ssh-key backup filename, consistent with data being carried in DNS. Given the decoded sensitive content, anomalous payload size, and recent domain registration, this activity is assessed as a genuine threat requiring escalation.
